widgets_values:
Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young East Asian woman in <Picture 1>, preserving her long black hair, pale celadon, mist-blue, and warm-ivory translucent hanfu, full-body position, raised arms, and joyful expression.
<Subject 2> is the colossal ancient pine in <Picture 1>, preserving its weathered bark, twisting overhead branches, hanging vines, dense needles, and dark upper-frame silhouette.
<Subject 3> is the cluster of oversized floating handwritten paper pages beneath the woman.
<Subject 4> is the glowing white paper crane, peach-pink petals, and loose paper fragments from <Picture 1>.
<Subject 5> is the pair of soft-focus first-person hands in the lower foreground of <Picture 1>.
<Picture 1> is the complete opening-frame anchor, preserving the low-angle 24mm composition, cloud sea, pale-blue sky, and warm upper-right backlight.

summary:
Full-reference image-to-video generation, vertical 9:16, 10 seconds. <Picture 1> is fully referenced at 00:00.000. Preserve all visible subjects while creating one continuous natural performance: the woman adjusts her balance on the floating pages, follows the paper crane with her body and gaze, extends her fingers toward it, then turns back with a small smile. Use three connected viewpoints with stable wind-driven environment motion.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>: fully_preserved at the opening, including the foreground hands, woman, ancient pine, paper pages, paper crane, petals, paper fragments, cloud sea, and warm upper-right light.
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved in identity, clothing, and starting pose; she makes a continuous weight shift, torso lean, arm extension, head turn, finger movement, and small smile.
<Subject 2>: fully_preserved; pine needles and vines move only with the same light wind affecting the woman.
<Subject 3>: fully_preserved; pages remain stable enough to stand on, with a small natural downward tilt during her weight shift.
<Subject 4>: fully_preserved; the crane moves slightly toward her hand and beats its wings once. Petals and fragments drift in one consistent direction.
<Subject 5>: fully_preserved in Shot 1 and naturally exits frame when the camera changes position.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic East Asian fantasy, vertical 9:16. At 00:00.000, <Picture 1> is fully referenced. The original low-angle full-body medium-long shot preserves <Subject 5> reaching upward in soft focus, <Subject 1> standing center-right on <Subject 3>, <Subject 4>'s paper crane just beyond her fingertips, and <Subject 2> framing the upper edge above the cloud sea. From 00:00.000 to 00:03.300, the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed for 0.35 meters. A light wind lifts the outer layer of <Subject 1>'s sleeves and streams her hair toward screen left. She shifts her weight onto her back foot, causing the nearest paper page to dip by only a few degrees and recover. She follows the crane with her eyes, leans her upper body forward slightly, and begins raising both hands farther toward it. Her foreground-facing fingers open naturally as the crane drifts a small distance upward.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.300, the camera cuts to a low-angle medium shot from the woman’s left side and trucks right with medium amplitude at slow speed for 0.75 meters. Her arm movement continues seamlessly: her elbows extend, wrists rotate upward, and her fingertips reach their highest point by 00:05.300. The crane responds with one gentle wingbeat and moves closer by less than half an arm’s length. She follows it by lifting her chin and rotating her torso slightly toward screen right. Her wide sleeve trails behind the movement, then settles. The pine branches remain overhead; cloud ridges separate softly through parallax. Two petals and one paper fragment drift past in the same wind direction, without swirls or light trails.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.700, the camera cuts to a side medium close-up that includes her face, raised hand, translucent sleeve, and the crane. The camera makes a slow 12-degree clockwise arc shot and holds until 00:10.000. Her fingers soften and curl slightly beneath the crane without touching it. She turns her eyes from the crane toward the camera’s direction, her mouth opens into a small genuine smile, and her shoulders lower as the wind eases. The crane stays suspended in front of her fingertips; page edges flutter faintly below. No new objects, no glowing burst, no particle swirl, no sudden camera shake, no text, no extra characters, and no distorted limbs.

overall_soundscape:
A continuous high-altitude breeze moves through pine needles, along the paper-page edges, and through the woman’s gauze sleeves. Petals and loose paper fragments make faint dry rustling sounds. The page platform gives one soft paper flex as she shifts her weight.

non_diegetic_music:
Sparse guqin notes begin under a long breathy xiao flute tone. A soft bowed-string swell enters as her arms reach their highest point, then fades gradually during her final smile.
